rows: Neutral jump: crouched takeoff with bent knees, rising tucked legs, apex with knees bent, descending legs extending. Fists in guard.
Forward jump facing right: forward takeoff, knees tucked with torso angled forward, apex extending front knee, descending ready to land.
Backward jump while facing right: back takeoff, torso tilted backward, knees tucked while retreating, descend extending back foot.
Falling: bent knees near apex, downward legs unfolding, extended legs preparing contact, slight knee bend near landing. Fists guard.
Landing: toe contact bent knees, deep compressed landing squat, halfway recovering upright, almost standing fighting guard.
Standing block: forearms shielding face, braced impact shoulders twist, absorb with tightened guard, reset shield.
Crouching block: deep low squat forearms shielding, low defensive recoil, brace low guard, reset still crouching.
Hit reaction: chest struck recoil, head and shoulders snap backward, torso hunched wincing, recover toward guard.
Quick jab: fist chambered guard, arm extending punch forward, fully extended sharp straight jab, elbow retracting to guard.
Heavy cross punch: weight coil and fist back, hip rotating powerful extension, maximum full punch reach, retract with shoulders recovering.
Forward advancing palm strike: forward step with open palm chambered, torso drives palm forward, full extended palm at face height, retract while planted.
Forward heavy rising roundhouse kick: knee chambered, leg sweeps upward forward, full leg extension at chest height, leg retracts. Both legs and arms anatomically correct.
Low crouching kick: low knee chambered, leg sliding outward, low kick fully extended near ankle height, leg retracts into low guard.
Low sweep: deeply squat weight on back leg, sweeping front leg, long low straight leg sweeping at floor level, recover crouched.
Neutral airborne punch: knees tucked fist back, punch extending while floating, full airborne jab forward, retract preparing landing.
Neutral airborne heavy kick: tucked knees, lead leg opening, full straight forward air kick, lead leg retracted.
Forward airborne punch: torso leaning forward knees trailing fist chamber, extending jab, fully stretched jump punch, retract toward landing.
Forward airborne heavy kick: knees tucked forward leap, lead leg extending, fully extended diagonal flying kick, retract lead leg.
Backward airborne punch facing RIGHT: backward torso lean with knees tucked, punch arm extending toward right, full jab while torso drifts backward, retract.
Backward airborne kick facing RIGHT: defensive tucked knees backward lean, rightward kick opening, full rightward kick while retreating, retract.
Knockdown: body falling onto back, lying curled on back, lying fully on back with knees bent, settled horizontal body on ground. Head to right feet left.
Wake up: lying on back, sitting propped on arm, one knee under torso rising, standing low fighting guard.
Thrown: limp body upright suspended, body tilts backward 25 degrees, tilts farther 50 degrees, horizontal airborne body HEAD RIGHT feet LEFT. No attacker drawn.
Frozen immobilized reaction: rigid standing posture tense arms, shivering braced posture, rigid recoil slightly crouched, rigid standing reset. NO ice graphics baked into body.

motionPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production pixel-art fighting-game animation atlas.
Primary request: redraw and animate Rafa Maré using the attached prototype as the identity reference. Fictitious young adult man, short spiky brown hair, athletic lean build, turquoise sleeveless athletic top, dark blue shorts, gray white sneakers, small blue wave tattoo on shoulder. Keep his proportions stylized, handsome original cartoon face, never a recognizable real person. Clean polished detailed 16-bit arcade sprite, sharp hard pixel clusters and restricted colors, no smooth painterly rendering. Side view facing RIGHT, 3/4 visible face.
Output EXACTLY 16 full-body frames, equally spaced in a 4-column by 4-row grid, square 2048x2048 atlas. All frames same head and torso size. Each cell 512x512; soles at local y=476, feet centered local x=256. Adult standing height 330 pixels. Padding 30 px around everything. Transparent background, NO checkerboard, no floor, no ground shadows, NO captions, no white residue or grid lines.
Row1: four DISTINCT idle fighting stance frames, fists guarding, soft knee and shoulder breathing, steady feet.
Row2: four DISTINCT forward-running cycle frames: right leg extended forward left back, knees crossing, left leg forward right back, other passing step; arms counter-swing. Lean forward, visible soles.
Row3: four DISTINCT backward retreat cycle frames keeping guard forward, alternating weight and steps.
Row4: four DISTINCT deep crouch frames, dropping into crouch, low guard, slight weight shift, rise halfway. No duplicate drawings.
One character per cell, never other characters, no weapons, no effects. Full body never cropped. Preserve clothes, hair, face and muscles exactly across all frames. The noisy white lines in the reference are export defects: omit them entirely.
